shorts.description:
On Venus, a single day (243 Earth days) is LONGER than an entire year (224.7 Earth days). The planet spins backwards, super slowly. If you lived there, you'd celebrate your birthday before finishing one day!

Follow Weird World Daily for more reality-breaking facts.
shorts.title: On Venus, a Day Is Longer Than a Year #shorts #facts #weirdfacts #foryou

shorts.description:
Your phone's GPS only works because Einstein was right. GPS satellites' clocks tick 38 microseconds faster per day (speed slows them, low gravity speeds them up). Without correcting for relativity, your maps would drift by kilometers within hours.

Subscribe to Weird World Daily — new weirdness every day.
